visualCharacteristics.purpose: news and blog feed cards with image, optional type label, linked title, date and author
visualCharacteristics.description: Light beige band. Three news cards in a row: dark image area with photo, white body (optional type eyebrow, bold linked title, bookmark icon, date and author link); third card fully dark with orange-highlighted title words. Centered row of two outlined pill buttons below.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item; cell 1 = article image; cell 2 = optional eyebrow paragraph, H3 linked title, date paragraph, "By" author link paragraph
contentPattern.description: Dynamic news/blog feed: items link to detail pages with dates and authors.

usage: Latest news / blog / press release teasers.
reuseGuidance: Any dated, authored article teaser list.
